# Phase 39: Farmer Confirmation Loop - Context

**Gathered:** 2026-05-13
**Status:** Ready for planning
**Mode:** Auto-generated by /gsd-autonomous after Phase 38 close (override: no clarifying questions)

<domain>
## Phase Boundary

A `signal_draft` row in status `awaiting_farmer` (produced by Phase 38) becomes either `confirmed` (handoff to Phase 40) or `discarded` / `expired` (terminal) through an explicit farmer reply, with EDIT looping back through the LLM, idempotent commit, and timeout-driven auto-discard.

**In scope (CONF-01..CONF-05):**
- Human-readable draft preview + reply-instruction Signal message on every Phase-38 hand-off (`awaiting_farmer`)
- YES → atomic `awaiting_farmer` → `confirmed` transition (idempotent: duplicate YES is a no-op)
- NO → `awaiting_farmer` → `discarded` with bot acknowledgement; original capture rows untouched
- EDIT `<text>` → re-runs Phase-38 extractor with the correction as additional context; replaces draft body in place; capped at N≥3 EDIT turns before escalating to "manual review"
- Timeout: pending draft + idle ≥ `DRAFT_PENDING_TIMEOUT_MIN` (default 30) → one nudge ping → auto-`expired`. Never auto-`confirmed`.
- One in-flight `awaiting_farmer` draft per farmer; sending YES/NO/EDIT against the most recent one (selection rule below).

**Out of scope (other phases):**
- farmOS API writes — Phase 40 reads `confirmed` rows.
- Multi-draft per page (paper-log batch mode, drafts.length > 1) — Phase 38 D-12 already routes those to `needs_review`, bypassing this loop. Phase 39 owns ONLY the conversational path (single draft).
- Cross-stream ingestion replay — Phase 41.
- SHI pilot lifecycle — Phase 42.
- Multi-farmer concurrency / group-thread reply routing on confirms — Phase 999.20 sub-part (b).

</domain>

<decisions>
## Implementation Decisions

### Reply Parser
- **D-01:** **First-token classifier on lowercased trimmed body.** `YES` / `Y` / `OK` / `SI` / `SÍ` → confirm; `NO` / `N` / `CANCEL` / `STOP` → discard; `EDIT <text>` or first-word other than the YES/NO families → treat as EDIT with the full reply body as correction text. Empty body or pure emoji/sticker → no-op (capture stored but no state transition; the next non-trivial reply wins). The classifier lives in `src/agents/alerter/src/confirm/parser.js`.
- **D-01a:** **Drafts and replies are paired by `(sender_e164, status=awaiting_farmer)` latest-by-`updated_at`.** If multiple `awaiting_farmer` rows exist for one sender (shouldn't, per D-02c in Phase 38, but defensive), the most recent wins; older ones are auto-`expired` at the same time with reason `superseded_by_newer_draft`. This is the same rule as Phase 38's "one in-flight draft per sender".

### Idempotency
- **D-02:** **Idempotency lives in the state machine, not in farmOS.** A duplicate YES on a draft already in `confirmed` is a no-op at the state-machine layer (`UPDATE ... WHERE status = 'awaiting_farmer' RETURNING id` — empty result = idempotent ignore). Phase 40 layers its own farmOS-side idempotency key (`draft.id`) on top; CONF-02 is satisfied at this layer alone.
- **D-02a:** **Bot acknowledgement on duplicate YES is a soft re-affirm**, not silence: "Already locked in -- check the previous message." Round numbers, no em-dashes (per memory `feedback_no_em_dashes_in_artifacts`, `feedback_round_farmer_numbers`).

### EDIT Loop
- **D-03:** **EDIT re-invokes the Phase-38 extractor with the original draft + the correction text as extra context.** Reuses `llm-client.js extract()` with `in_flight_draft` and a new `farmer_correction` argument. The extractor returns a revised `draft` and `per_field_confidence`; the existing draft row is **updated in place** (no new row), `edit_turn_count` increments, status stays `awaiting_farmer`, and the preview is re-rendered + re-sent.
- **D-03a:** **EDIT cap = 3 (`MAX_EDIT_TURNS=3`, env-configurable).** On the 4th EDIT against the same draft, bot replies with the escalation message: "I cannot get this right after 3 tries -- try splitting the message into smaller updates, or use /skip to discard." Draft status flips to `needs_review` (terminal for this loop; Phase 38's needs-review handler owns the rest).
- **D-03b:** **EDIT is allowed even after an ask-back round in Phase 38.** Phase 38's ask-back turn count (`askback_turn_count`, capped at 3) and Phase 39's edit turn count are **separate counters** — the farmer can use both budgets independently.

### Timeout / Stale-Draft Watchdog
- **D-04:** **Timeout = `DRAFT_PENDING_TIMEOUT_MIN` (default 30min).** Computed from `signal_draft.updated_at` (so a successful ask-back response or EDIT resets the clock, but the initial Phase-38 hand-off message also counts as activity).
- **D-04a:** **Nudge happens once, at `0.8 × timeout` (default 24min).** Bot sends a soft reminder: "Still want to lock in the [draft preview gist]? Reply YES / NO / EDIT or it auto-expires in 6 min." Setting `nudge_sent_at` prevents double-nudging. **No farmer-facing decimals** — round to whole minutes.
- **D-04b:** **At full timeout, status → `expired`** with a final "Draft expired -- nothing was written. Send a fresh message if you still want to log this." note. Never auto-`confirmed`.
- **D-04c:** **Watchdog is a periodic polling worker, not a per-draft timer.** A single interval (every 60s, `DRAFT_WATCHDOG_INTERVAL_MS=60000`) scans for `awaiting_farmer` rows that crossed nudge / expire thresholds. Simpler than a per-draft `setTimeout` and survives alerter restarts because state lives in Timescale.
- **D-04d:** **Restart safety.** On alerter start-up, the watchdog runs immediately (not just after the first interval), so a draft that crossed timeout during a restart still fires nudge/expire without farmer-visible jitter.

### Draft Preview Renderer
- **D-05:** **One renderer shared with Phase 38's ask-back preview.** Phase 38 already has `preview-builder.js` producing the `[?]` ask-back view; Phase 39 reuses it WITHOUT the `[?]` markers (since by `awaiting_farmer` time every field is at-or-above the confidence threshold or already explicitly confirmed). The "Reply YES to commit, NO to discard, EDIT <text> to amend" suffix is appended by `confirm/preview.js`. Cap preview length at ~1500 chars; on long previews, paginate per Signal message limits.
- **D-05a:** **Preview is the ONLY farmer-facing rendering of a confirmed/discarded draft.** No re-render on YES (the bot reply is just "Locked in -- writing now" with the draft id for trace). On NO, bot reply is "Discarded -- nothing written."
- **D-05b:** **Style locks.** Round numbers via `fmtNum()` (already in `src/agents/alerter/src/message.js`); no em-dashes; address operator as "Don Santiago" in batch-summary contexts only — farmer messages use the farmer's first name when known (Phase 37 farmos_person lookup).

### Reply Routing
- **D-06:** **Bot replies go to the same target the draft was hand-off-sent to.** Phase 38 records `reply_target_kind` (DM vs group) and `reply_target_id` on the draft (inherited from `signal_capture`); Phase 39 reads those, not `SIGNAL_RECIPIENT`. Closes the 999.20 reply-routing bug for the confirm loop specifically (group-thread participation still deferred — confirm loop on group sends DMs to the originating farmer for now per D-06a).
- **D-06a:** **For v1.7, even if the draft originated in the Mush Farm group, the confirm loop sends DMs to the originating sender, not back to the group.** Rationale: confirms are personal acks ("Locked in"), group spam is the 999.20 anti-pattern that bit us during Phase 36 receive verification. Group-mode confirm UX is a future-phase question.

### State Persistence
- **D-07:** **Reuse `signal_draft` table.** Phase 38 already provisions `status`, `askback_turn_count`, `updated_at`, `farmer_facing_preview`. Add columns (idempotent migration): `edit_turn_count int default 0`, `nudge_sent_at timestamptz null`, `confirmed_at timestamptz null`, `discarded_at timestamptz null`, `expired_at timestamptz null`, `terminal_reason text null` (`farmer_yes` / `farmer_no` / `superseded_by_newer_draft` / `timeout_expired` / `edit_cap_exceeded`). Confirms write `confirmed_at = NOW()` atomically with the status transition.
- **D-07a:** **Audit trail = `signal_draft_event` append-only table.** Every state transition (preview_sent, nudge_sent, yes, no, edit, expired, edit_cap_exceeded) gets one row keyed by `draft_id` + `seq`. Lets Phase 40's audit query show the full conversation for any committed write. Schema: `(draft_id text, seq int, event text, payload jsonb, created_at timestamptz, primary key (draft_id, seq))`.

### Outbound Path
- **D-08:** **All Phase 39 outbound messages go through the existing `signal.js` send helpers** (DM + group). No new transport layer. Confirm loop runs inline in the alerter receive-loop (not a separate worker) — Phase 38's extraction worker may be inline OR external (per Phase 38 D-claude's-discretion); Phase 39's state-machine transitions are cheap and synchronous on the receive path.

### Test / UAT Scope
- **D-09:** **Phase 39 ships with a synthetic confirm-loop test harness** (unit + integration) covering the 5 success-criteria scenarios from ROADMAP plus the 3-EDIT cap, the duplicate-YES no-op, the nudge timing, and the superseded-by-newer-draft path. Real-farmer Signal UAT is operator-deferred (same pattern as Phase 25/37) and lives in a `39-RUNBOOK.md`.
- **D-09a:** **Real-data ship-gate per `feedback_real_data_before_ship_gate_pass`:** at least one fixture must use a real prod inoc draft from `/mnt/mossrock/shared/mushdatadump-prod/`. Curated-only PASS is insufficient.

### Claude's Discretion
- Exact wording of preview suffixes, nudge text, escalation message (subject to style locks D-05b).
- Whether the watchdog runs in a setInterval inside the alerter process or as a separate compose service — recommend in-process unless benchmark shows >5% receive-loop latency cost.
- Test harness file layout (`tests/integration/confirm/...` vs `src/agents/alerter/test/confirm/...`) — match Phase 38 conventions.
- Migration commit shape (single migration touching `signal_draft` + `signal_draft_event`, or two).
- Whether to use a transaction for the atomic YES handoff (recommended — `BEGIN; UPDATE ... WHERE status='awaiting_farmer'; INSERT INTO signal_draft_event; COMMIT;`).

</decisions>

## Existing Code Insights

### Reusable Assets
- **`signal_draft` table (Phase 38):** Already provisioned with `status`, `askback_turn_count`, `farmer_facing_preview`, `source_capture_ids`, `sender_e164`. Phase 39 ALTERs in additional columns idempotently.
- **`preview-builder.js` (Phase 38):** Renders the asset-creates + log-creates summary. Phase 39 reuses with a flag to omit `[?]` markers.
- **`llm-client.js extract()` (Phase 38):** Accepts `in_flight_draft` and (with D-03 amendment) a new `farmer_correction` argument for EDIT re-runs.
- **`signal.js` send helpers + `capture-db.js`:** Standard outbound + persistence patterns.
- **`receive-loop.js` (Phase 37):** Sender identity resolved before any extraction or confirm-loop work.

### Established Patterns
- **Idempotent migrations:** `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` + `ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS` at module init (capture-db.js:5-35).
- **Env-driven thresholds:** `DRAFT_PENDING_TIMEOUT_MIN`, `MAX_EDIT_TURNS`, `DRAFT_WATCHDOG_INTERVAL_MS` live in `config.js` + `.env` (per `feedback_compose_env_passthrough_not_envfile.md` — when adding new env vars, ship the matching `- X=${X:-default}` line in `docker-compose.override.yml` in the same PR).
- **Farmer-facing formatting:** `fmtNum()` for numbers; no em-dashes; named address.
- **Pool injection for DB modules.**
- **Append-only event log (Phase 25 lineage):** `signal_capture` is append-only; `signal_draft_event` follows the same shape.

### Integration Points
- **Inbound (from Phase 38):** New `awaiting_farmer` row + `farmer_facing_preview` set → confirm-loop renderer sends preview + reply-instructions.
- **Inbound (from receive-loop):** Reply parser intercepts before extraction if a sender has an `awaiting_farmer` draft. If parser classifies as YES/NO/EDIT, drive state machine. Otherwise the message is a fresh capture and goes through normal Phase 38 extraction (which Phase 38 D-12 / D-01a handles, including idle-gap forced start-new).
- **Outbound (to Phase 40):** `confirmed` rows are the seam Phase 40 picks up.
- **Audit (to ops):** `signal_draft_event` rows are the seam Phase 40's FOS-06 audit-log query joins on.

<specifics>
## Specific Ideas

- **The confirm loop is the NORTH-STAR enforcement point.** Phase 40 doesn't write to farmOS without a row in `confirmed` status — so Phase 39 is the gate that ensures no farmOS write happens without a farmer YES. Get this layer right and the rest of v1.7 inherits "no farmer bookkeeping tax + no silent wrong writes."
- **Real-data ship-gate is non-negotiable** (`feedback_real_data_before_ship_gate_pass`). Same lesson as Phase 38: curated unit tests pass != production works.
- **Watchdog restart safety matters in practice** — fc-core has been restarted ~6× in the last week per memory; alerter restarts will happen during v1.7 build-out. A draft that nudges or expires correctly across a restart is a real, observable property the operator will hit during dogfooding.
- **EDIT loop = real LLM round-trip = real $$$.** Per `feedback_smoke_before_expensive_batch` + `feedback_persist_paid_results_default`: the integration test fixtures should mock the LLM, and any live-API smoke MUST per-call unique paths + JSONL append-only. Don't repeat the Plan 09 paid-result-overwrite mistake.
- **Group-thread bot reply IS a 999.20 question, not Phase 39.** Phase 39 D-06a punts to DM-on-confirm regardless of draft origin; revisit when 999.20 group-mode lands.

</specifics>

<deferred>
## Deferred Ideas

- **Group-thread confirm replies** — sending "Locked in" back to the Mush Farm group on a draft that originated there. 999.20 sub-part (b) territory.
- **Multi-language YES/NO classifier** — beyond the basic SI / SÍ already in D-01. The bot speaks English; farmers code-switch but the YES/NO surface is tiny.
- **Inline `/cancel` slash command vs free-text NO** — slash commands are a future UX layer; the free-text classifier in D-01 is sufficient for v1.7.
- **Farmer-tunable timeout** (e.g. "/nudge_in 45m") — ops-side env-only for v1.7.
- **Bot-initiated "are you sure?" on destructive drafts** (e.g. archive_spent on a block with active harvest logs) — interesting but layers above CONF-01..05; v1.8 territory.
- **Concurrent in-flight drafts per farmer** — Phase 38 D-02c locks this at 1; Phase 39 inherits. Multi-draft farmer queues are a future UX/state-machine extension.
- **Multi-farmer reply routing tests on confirm path** — 999.20 is the headline tracker; revisit Phase 39's reply-target behaviour during 999.20 closure.
